notes: complete-inputs: with_skill 6/6 vs without_skill 3/6 — baseline made catastrophic calc error (117,752/group vs correct ~18,500). Skill clearly adds value here.
missing-inputs: with_skill 6/6 vs without_skill 4/6 — baseline gave '1-3 weeks' as headline answer. Skill properly labels all numbers as 'Illustration Only' scenarios.

unsafe-traffic REVERSED: with_skill 3/5 vs without_skill 4/5 — skill warns about traffic correctly but has formula bug (3,078 instead of ~1,538). Baseline surprisingly calculates correctly but doesn't warn explicitly.

Formula bug in skill: for conversion metrics the model applies an extra ×2 factor when reading skill instructions, giving double the correct per-group sample. Root cause: REFERENCE.md is conceptual, no explicit formula.
Key recommendation: add explicit formula to REFERENCE.md for conversion metrics to prevent the ×2 error.
